title: PH60039: Biophysics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Molecular bonding and structure :covalent, ionic bond, Resonance bond, H-bond
Intermolecular interaction : Van der Waal type, Effect of the medium ,screening
of field Hydro-phobic and Hydro-philic interaction, Bilayer formation ,protein
folding, DNA melting Physical methods for shape , size and mass determination
of bio-molecules Spectroscopic methods: Dielectric spectroscopic method,
EIS,NMR and MRI Infrared, Visible and ultraviolet spectroscopy, Fluorescence,
Physics of Imaging Cellular electricity, Nernst- Planck equation, Donnan
equilibrium, Goldman equation, Action Potential, Ion-channel, propagation of
Nerve impulse, Cable model, Hodgkin-Huxley model, Noble model for heart.
